5. Material 5.1 In case of battery locomotives with flameproof characteristics, every locomotive and each of ib accessories shall, as far as practicable, be constructed of non-flammable material. Any inflam mable material included therein, shall be shrouded with a substantial metallic covering to rende it non-flammable.

7.8.14 Cables for internal wiring of the locomotive shall conform to IS : 1554 ( Part I)-1964 ` PVC insulated (heavy duty) electric cables: Part I For working voltages up to and including 1 100 volts (revised) ' or IS : 694 ( Part I )-I964 ` PVC insulated cables (for voltages up to 1 100 V ): Part I With copper conductors ( revised ) `. 7.9 Electrical Equipments

7.9.1 For battery locomotives with flameproof characteristics, enclosures of all electrical equipments, for example, motor; controller, resistance boxes, circuit breaker unit, light, etc, except battery covers shall conform to the requirements of IS : 2148-1968 `Flameproof enclosures of electrical apparatus `. 7.9.1.1In case of locomotives with flameproof characteristics, electrical meters, such as voltmeter, ammeter, speedometer, etc, shall be placed in an explosion proof voltage resistant ceil. The compasses of metres shall be clearly visible from outside. The cell shall conform to requirements of lS : 2148-1968. 7.9.2 Main parameters motors may be of special 7.9.3 Controller 7.9.3.1 The battery locomotive or thyristor type controller, shall be provided with either direct manually operated controller of the traction motor shall conform to Table shape to suit the design of locomotives. 2. The design of dc traction

7.9.3.2 In case of direct controller, the design of the controller shall be such that for the purpose of accelerating and reversing the locomotives, the switching of main current is done entirely within the controller housing either by manually rotated drums on which segments carrying current are mounted or by manually rotated cams which actuate contactors carrying the current. Accelerating and reversing drums or cams shall be provided usually on separate interlocked shafts so that the accelerating shaft cannot rotate unless the reversing shaft is in either the ` forward ' or, I reverse ' position and the reversing shaft cannot be rotated unless the accelerating shaft is in the ` off ' position. Numbers of notch of controller shall be as specified in Table 2. 7.9.4 Resistance boxes-Resistances smooth starting and controlling the operation. 7.9.5 Circuit breaker unit in the resistance boxes if used, shall be designed for traction motors of the locomotives for parallel and series

7.9.5.1 It shall consist of a circuit breaker, one ampere-hour meter and a e-pin plug and socket. Interlocking shall be provided to ensure that the plug can be removed only after disconnecting the A voltmeter and an ammeter may be used in place of ampere-hour meter. supply from the battery. 7

9. Control 9.1 Double end control may be provided in either driving on the locomotive direction shall of 13 tonnes nominal static weight. with double end

9.1.1 Good visibility control.

be assured

in locomotives

P

9.2 The locomotives with double end control sh311 be provided with two drum controller, one at each end, and connected electrically. Control for braking, sanding and signal systems shall also be provided at each end. A suitable device shall be provided to operate the circuit breaker from both ends of the locomotives. 9.2.1 Arrangement shall be msde in locomotives.to isolate the control stand which is not in use.

10. Heat Treatment - Heat treatment of each component shall depend on material, shape and size of the components. Heat treatment of components of couplings and draw gear shall be done to obtain a factor of safety of seven with respact to maximum tractive effort of locomotive. 11. Marking -Battery name-plate: box of the locomotive shall be marked with the following information on a

a) Type ayd numbers of cells, and b) Nominal voltage of battery. 11.1 Each locomotive shall be marked suitable place in the locomotive. a) b) c) d) -e) f) with the following informations on a name-plate placed at a

Type and SI No. of the locomotive, Manufacturing date and identification number, Static weight in kg, Tractive effort at hourly rating in kg, Maximum speed of the locomotive at hourly rating in km/h, and Name of the manufacturer and identification mark. Marking Details available with the Indian Standards Institution.
